newsitem.title: USA: Pepsi says Andrall Pearson to head spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Pepsi says Andrall Pearson to head spinoff.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc said Monday it will bring in a top buyout firm executive to head its $10 billion restaurant spinoff.
Andrall Pearson, an operating partner of Clayton, Dubilier & Rice, will become chairman of the yet-to-be-named spinoff, PepsiCo said.

A former Harvard Business School professor with experience in the consumer products, retailing and franchising industries, Pearson will set the overall strategy for the new company, whose businesses include Pizza Hut, KFC and Taco Bell.
PepsiCo said David Novak -- formerly the chief operating officer for PepsiCola North America -- will serve as the new company's vice chairman and president.
Novak will be responsible for operating the business and developing the Pizza Hut, KFC and Taco Bell brands, PepsiCo said.
The new company will comprise over 29,000 restaurants in 95 countries, PepsiCo said.
